notes: PC Box (Pokemon storage) UI application, one address-ordered chunk of overlay_14 (~0x021EAF08-0x021EE000). All ~90 thumb_func_start entries are STATIC except 4 exported (ov14_021EAF08, ov14_021EAF8C, ov14_021EC710, ov14_021ED5B0). Nearly every function takes r0 = PCBoxAppWork* (0x38-byte work). Master jump table ov14_021F7D9C (this chunk .rodata) is indexed by work->state (work+0x30), ~179 fn pointers spanning many sibling ov14 chunks; ov14_021EAF8C reads *pState, calls table[state](work), stores return back to *pState. Work layout confirmed from PCBox_Init (asm/overlay_14_021E5900.s: OverlayManager_CreateAndGetData size 0x38). work+0x34 = PCBoxData* (heap 0x88E0 in ov14_021EAFAC). Most static handlers: int fn(PCBoxAppWork *work) returning next state index (or a callback-registration result via ov14_021F0234).

Emit table here in exact order with extern forward-decls; rodata order (021F7D1C, 021F7D2C, 021F7D3C, 021F7D50, 021F7D74, 021F7D78, 021F7D9C) must match asm exactly.

INLINE SWITCH TABLES (add pc,r0 + .short deltas) in ov14_021EB2EC and ov14_021EB388 are MWCC switch lowering, NOT data - write as C switch.
~90 functions, only 4 exported. Keep other ~86 static to avoid IPA header churn; do not add beyond the 4 public symbols to any shared header.
